interventions.who: EAU guideline specialist; speaks only from the guideline text he retrieved
interventions.body:
**GUIDELINE**
"Weak\nOmit biopsy and offer PSA monitoring when MRI is negative (i.e. PI-RADS ≤ 2), and clinical suspicion of PCa is low (PSA density < 0.20 ng/mL/cc and no family history)."

**WHAT THE EXPERTS DO NOT SETTLE**
The experts have not settled on a definitive action. The decision hinges on the interpretation of the PI-RADS score (2) in the context of the PSA level (9.9 ng/mL) and the prior negative biopsy. The benefit node for treatment was at chance (AUC 0.5645), indicating the model carries no discriminatory information for treatment benefit.

**WHAT THE DOCUMENTS MUST SETTLE**
The documents must settle on the appropriate next step following the prior negative biopsy, specifically whether to continue surveillance, proceed to a repeat biopsy, or pursue further imaging, given the current PSA of 9.9 ng/mL and PI-RADS 2.
